The newest Gemma generation. It gives top quality on your device.
The largest model. It writes the best, but it needs a powerful device.
NVIDIA's retraining of Gemma 4 E4B for following instructions and using tools. Text only, and it needs a powerful device.
A small Gemma from the previous generation. It has good quality and a context of 4K tokens.
Clearly smarter than the models below 1B. It needs a mid-range device.
A recent small model. The quality is high for its size.
A general-purpose model that still fits on a basic device.
The smallest Gemma from Google. It is fast on all devices.
Very small and fast. It is good for quick rewrites, but the reasoning is limited.
A recent mid-size model that thinks before it answers. It needs a mid-range device.
Meta\'s small Llama. It writes clear English and follows instructions well.
A small Gemma from the previous generation. No Hugging Face token is needed for this file.
Reads pictures and screenshots well, the text in them too. It needs a high-end device. Its licence allows research use only.
A very small model that can read pictures. It describes a picture, but often misreads the text in a screenshot.
Small and fast. It is good for quick rewrites on a basic device.
